conclusions: The fixed governor improves observed liquidation drawdown and daily losses through reduced inventory; it does not improve the input signal or forecast.
Governed sign-trend-90d beats governed multiscale in net P&L in every 2024 scenario; both assets remain positive in all four governed candidate scenarios.
The governor reduces fees and funding through less exposure and turnover, but the reduction in price earnings is larger, so net P&L is lower than its ungoverned counterpart.
No candidate accounting, daily-loss, or permanent drawdown latch fired in this development window. Most reductions reflect continuous risk scaling.
The joint lot/cost optimizer can hold cash with a positive target. When all minimum lots exceed the remaining cap, flat inventory cannot recover the drawdown buffer through price gains.

Funding timestamp interpretation materially changes the governed constant-ETH stress path: small cash differences affect lot feasibility and subsequent exposure. This is a robustness limitation, not a data timing resolution.
All eight ungoverned v2 saved runs are byte-identical to the corresponding saved v1 runs, including their input receipts.
These are 2024 development outcomes under hourly execution proxies and unresolved funding timestamps; they do not establish live profitability.

definitions.flatDespiteNonzeroScaledDesireHoldHours: Hourly plans that return HOLD with zero gross inventory and at least one nonzero desired asset target.
definitions.minimumLotBlocked: For each desired asset, its minimum order notional at the plan risk price exceeds the entire current cap; this is a sufficient infeasibility condition.
definitions.dailyLoss: Calendar-day net loss is reported for both variants. Intraday liquidation loss from the governor is reported only for governed runs; no ungoverned value was fabricated.
definitions.pricePnl: Realized plus terminal unrealized price P&L at simulated execution prices, already incorporating slippage; fees and funding are deducted separately.
definitions.riskReasonCounts: PRE_TRADE observations before endMs; multiple reasons may apply within one hour.
definitions.maximumMarkedGrossExposureUsd: Includes pre-adjustment mark movement. Dynamic caps constrain planned/reserved exposure and can be exceeded by price gaps between checks.
